notes: covered by dino8-kernel/tests/extra/rowwork3_blender_mesh_edit_oracles.cpp; closed-form/oracle: ExtrudeIndividualFaces (the same kernel operation as Extrude Individual Faces and Move, mesh row D8-BLENDER-MESH-0043). notes: covered by dino8-kernel/tests/extra/rowwork3_blender_mesh_edit2_oracles.cpp; closed-form/oracle: ExtrudeFaceRegion. Oracle: a 2 x 2 x 1 slab (volume 4) whose top is cut into 4 unit quads: raising a 1 x 2 patch of 2 quads by 3 along its +z normal gives a closed manifold of volume 4 + 2*3 = 10, area slab + 6 walls * (1 * 3), 6 new faces and 6 new vertices (the shared middle edge gets no wall); documentation: Blender Manual, docs.blender.org/manual/en/latest/modeling/meshes/editing/face/ (page 'Extrude Region'; definition paraphrased: extrudes the selected faces as one piece, moved along the region normal); the manual page could not be fetched from this sandbox (network policy), so the definition is paraphrased from recollection and the sentence is not quoted: from recollection, needs owner/independent check; python API: https://docs.blender.org/api/current/; Tested: a flat region moved along its normal. Untested: curved regions (Blender moves along vertex normals with the Shrink/Fatten variants, here one area-weighted region normal), inward extrusion over an existing rim, the interactive move. Untested: the edit-mode selection scoping (the operator acts on the current selection only), the operator-level clear-error report (the kernel function throws std::invalid_argument), the single undo step, and comparison against Blender's own output data.
